watches.name: The Driving with Jonny Limited Edition
watches.description: Inspired by 1970s performance watches and renowned automotive journalist Jonny Lieberman , the Sheffield DWJ Automatic blends vintage motorsport heritage with modern watchmaking. As Senior Features Editor at MotorTrend , host of Driving With Jonny , and a regular on Spike's Car Radio , Jonny has spent decades driving extraordinary cars on legendary tracks, including the Nürburgring and Pikes Peak. The standout feature is the 90-degree tilted blue dial , inspired by vintage rally watches for easy readability behind the wheel. The custom-tooled 316L stainless steel case houses a reliable NH35 automatic movement , protected by a single-domed sapphire crystal with anti-glare coating. A second crown operates the internal rotating bezel. With 100 meters of water resistance , a stainless steel Milanese mesh bracelet with adjustable sliding clasp, and a custom DWJ-engraved caseback , this watch delivers distinctive racing character and everyday durability. Built for the drive. Designed for the enthusiast. PRE-ORDER NOW! SHIPPING LATE NOVEMBER

watches.name: 1A 40mm Steel Automatic (Right or Left)
watches.description: The Sheffield 1A Steel Automatic takes a classic tool-watch approach, available in both left- and right-hand crown configurations , featuring a black dial with highly legible markers and hands. The 40mm 316L stainless steel case , sapphire crystal, and unique 12-hour steel bezel complement the reliable Japanese Miyota 8215 automatic movement . A stainless steel bracelet with a side-release clasp completes the look and gives the watch its “Steel” name. When we first revived Sheffield three years ago, we offered the Diver 1 with a left-hand crown. That distinctive feature returns by popular demand in this new automatic model. The 12-hour rotating bezel also provides a simple, practical alternative to a GMT function, allowing you to track a second time zone without the complexity of an additional hand.

watches.name: Jay Leno’s Garage Turbine Watch
watches.description: The New Jay Leno’s Garage Turbine Watch is inspired by this unique and classic vehicle as well as the connection to Jay ’s youth and the story of his first encounter to his restoration of the Turbine. Much like the car, the 316L polished and satin finish case has a classic fine knurled edge drawn from the Turbine’s signature headlight design. The single domed sapphire crystal protects the elegantly numbered textured dial. The inner ring reflects the unique color of the car with the date at the 6 as a final touch. The sapphire case back showcases the venerable 24 jewel NH35 Automatic movement. A genuine leather quick-release strap completes this unique and classic homage to Jay ’s ’63 Chrysler Turbine.

watches.name: QL1.2 Yellow
watches.description: A top seller in the QL series , the QL1.2 Yellow takes the original QL1 experiment to the next level, now with fully lumed markers alongside the existing lumed hands. The challenge from the beginning was simple: how much meaningful specification could we build into a reliable, unique watch while staying true to the Sheffield value ethos? Two things were essential: a reliable Miyota 2035 quartz movement and 5 ATM (150 feet) of water resistance , giving you the confidence to handle everyday exposure to water without worry. The rest of the build is equally purposeful, with an alloy case, hardened mineral glass crystal, and rugged, easily interchangeable nylon strap . Originally inspired by the bright Porsche colors of the 1960s and 1970s, Yellow has become one of the most popular expressions of the QL design , paired with the signature pilot-style tilted dial and offset crown position that give the QL its unmistakable character.

The fully luminescent dial and lumed hands create a highly legible watch that stands out both day and night while maintaining the distinctive character that defines the QL1 collection.

watches.name: 1A 40mm
watches.description: The 1A 40 has always been core to the Sheffield story. It was the first true update of my original Sheffield Diver, now refined with a steel coin-edge bezel that is even truer to the original. More than 50 years after I received my first Sheffield in 1970, this watch represents a dream turned reality. Incredible specifications and build quality come together in a distinctive design that still stands out today while respecting the intent of the original.

specsRaw.Sheffield Watches: Heritage you can afford. Quality you can't ignore.

watches.name: 1A 40mm Steel City
watches.description: Now a permanent addition to the Sheffield range. We offered the popular limited-edition Steel City models in ’24 and ’25, but decided it was time to make the Steel City a steady offering. Sheffield Watches started in the U.S. in the ’60s, and we brought the brand back in 2023. When we revived Sheffield, the UK, and Sheffield in particular, embraced us in a special way. Orders. Encouragement. Real support. This isn’t a tribute watch. It’s a statement of sincere thanks and a special variation of the 1A 40, featuring white Swiss lume indices , a clean no-date dial , and the distinctive block-style Sheffield logo . The Union Jack recognizes our “cousins” across the pond who continue to support Sheffield. Offered globally.

specsRaw.Sheffield Watches: Heritage you can afford. Quality you can't ignore.

watches.name: 1A 38 Silver 2.0
watches.description: The 1A 38 Silver returns with new elevated details. The silver sunburst dial now features gilded hands and markers, both enhanced with Swiss Super-LumiNova® for superior legibility. The 38mm 316L stainless steel case features proportions and scale inspired by early Sheffield Diver cases. The unidirectional bezel has clean steel markers with no lume. Engineered for performance, it’s equipped with a screw-down crown, anti-glare sapphire crystal, and 20 ATM (200-meter) water resistance. At its core, the watch is powered by the reliable NH35 automatic movement, delivering precision and durability. Completing the package is a genuine black leather Rally strap. The updated 1A 38 Silver is one of our most versatile transitional watches, equally at home for utility, casual wear, or under the cuff.

specsRaw.Sheffield Watches: Heritage you can afford. Quality you can't ignore.

watches.name: Rally 2.0
watches.description: The Rally has been stylishly updated to further reflect its relationship to the mechanical allure of classic cars. We’ve added an exhibtion sapphire case back featuring the inner workings of the sturdy Miyota 8215 automatic movement and we have also updatd and improved the genuine leather Rally strap. The inspiration for the design remains The same: The famous Nardi steering wheel, coveted as an accessory for Porsche* 356 cars of the 1950s and 1960s, as well as Ferraris and other classics. Nardi steering wheel variations are quite beautiful, and I chose the one most often seen in the 356.

watches.name: Brian’s Sheffield
watches.description: Brian’s Sheffield is a special-edition chronograph created in honor of Brian LaViolette and his lifelong love of watches. Its striking green sunburst dial, designed by acclaimed watch photographer Ty Alexander, is accented by gold seconds and subdial hands, a subtle tribute to the Green Bay Packers watch that sparked Brian’s passion for watches at just four years old. Powered by the Seiko VK64 mecha-quartz movement, the watch combines the accuracy and reliability of quartz timekeeping with the smooth sweep and mechanical feel of a traditional chronograph. More than a watch, Brian’s Sheffield supports a remarkable legacy. Sheffield will donate $100 from every watch sold to the Brian LaViolette Scholarship Foundation , which has awarded more than 1,200 scholarships in Brian’s memory.

watches.name: Solar Ceramic
watches.description: The Solar Ceramic Chronograph was inspired by Spike Feresten of Spike's Car Radio and built for athletes who demand durability without sacrificing style. Featuring a lightweight 43mm white ceramic case, domed anti-reflective sapphire crystal, and 100-meter water resistance, it's designed to handle everything from the tennis court to the trail or pool. Powered by the Epson VS75B solar chronograph movement with a 10-year rechargeable battery, it also features Swiss C3 Super-LumiNova and includes two quick-release 22mm FKM rubber straps in white and blue for easy customization.

watches.name: Deep Gray 300
watches.description: The Sheffield Deep Gray 300 is the first Sheffield diver engineered and tested for 300 meters of water resistance. To achieve this, we developed an all-new 42mm case crafted from 316L stainless steel, designed not only to withstand the pressure of deep water, but to securely house every component within. At its core is the reliable NH35 automatic movement, protected by an anti-reflective sapphire crystal and paired with highly visible C3 Swiss lume on the dial, hands, and bezel insert for exceptional readability in any conditions. Heavy-duty spring bars connect a matching nylon web strap to robust 22mm lugs featuring Sheffield's signature external detailing. The full-wrap hook-and-loop closure provides a secure, comfortable fit whether worn directly on the wrist or over a wetsuit. Built for adventure above and below the surface, the Deep Gray 300 combines Sheffield's vintage-inspired design language with modern durability and performance.

White Swiss lume markers and a blue Tropic-style FKM rubber diver strap complete the distinctive SCR II Blue presentation.

watches.name: Chrono II Blue
watches.description: Chrono II Steel Blue is the latest addition to the Chrono II series. It carries the same detailed dial design as the classic black and white models, with styling inspired by Sheffield chronographs from the 1960s. Powering the chronograph is the VK64 mecha-quartz movement. Timekeeping is regulated by a quartz movement, while the stopwatch functions are driven by a mechanical chronograph module, delivering a smooth sweeping seconds hand rather than the typical quartz tick. Both systems are powered by a single battery, resulting in the reliability and accuracy of quartz timekeeping combined with the mechanical feel and intricacy of a traditional chronograph.

watches.name: World Time Solar
watches.description: The World Time is a model derived from a 1960s Sheffield World Time watch design. This modern rendition features the proven Miyota 2070 Solar Quartz movement, the same reliable platform found across several Solar and GT models in the range. Swiss lume–filled markers now slightly enlarged for clarity day and night sit on a dial that pays homage to the original design, highlighted by a subtle touch of red at the tip of the seconds hand. The unidirectional world bezel stands out with its city designations, allowing you to align your current city and instantly track the time almost anywhere in the world. A stainless steel bracelet with updated side button release clasp provides the perfect finishing touch to this special model.

The timekeeping function is controlled by the venerable MechaQuartz VK 64 quartz movement whereas the stopwatch features of the chronograph are managed by a mechanical component and a sweeping seconds hand unlike the tick of a quartz seconds hand. These functions are sustained by a shared power source in a single battery. The result is the reliability of a quartz movement and the intricacy of mechanical components in its chronograph function.

watches.description: The Solar Steel is an homage to the classic steel case and bracelet tool watch. If I had brought this out as my first watch, I think it would have been seen as "well that's easy...just like a lot of microbrand tool watches." So I waited these last two years before bringing out my interpretation. I wanted to add value and interest by powering it with the Miyota 2070 Solar quartz movement used in the GT range. Honestly, I really like this watch a lot! The piano black bezel is just right. It has all the key specs: 20 ATM water resistance, 316L steel case with drilled lugs and engraved case back, Swiss lume on the dial and Japan lume on the bezel, sapphire crystal with anti-glare coating, and steel bracelet with updated side button release clasp.

watches.name: Jay Leno's Garage Limited Edition Mechanic's Pit Watch
watches.description: Borrowing style and cues from the classic design of Jay's Drivers Watch this new model has the same rugged 316L Steel Case but with a sandblasted finish to better hide the likely scratches a mechanic would tend to add to the watch surface while working in tight spaces. The steel case back has Jay's Signature and Thank You engraving. The chronograph is powered by the sturdy VK 64 Mecha-Quartz movement which combines a mechanical component for a smooth sweep second hand. The sapphire crystal with anti-glare coating protects a bright white textured dial with easy to read enlarged 60 minute sub-dial opposite the 24 hour sub-dial. The bright lume is Swiss and the watch is pressurized for 100 Meter Water Resistance. The black FKM rubber strap with quick release can be cleaned easily after being exposed to the engine work a mechanic is likely to do. A second leather strap is included if you want to dress the watch up.

watches.name: 1A 38 Black/Orange
watches.description: The 1A 38 Black/Orange is a meticulously crafted timepiece, staying true to the design of Sheffield's iconic 1960s diver. It features a black dial with distinctive block-shaped orange and white markers, both enhanced with Swiss Super-LumiNova® for superior legibility. Encased in a 38mm stainless steel case, this production run boasts a non-lume steel bezel with "mil-spec" one-minute markers found on early divers. Engineered for performance, it's equipped with a screw-down crown, anti-glare sapphire crystal, and 20 ATM (200-meter) water resistance. At its core, the watch is powered by the reliable NH35 automatic movement, ensuring precision and durability. Completing the package is a classic Tropic-style FKM rubber strap, offering both flexibility and resilience. And the most requested feature: NO DATE! Enthusiasts have long asked for a no-date automatic, and this is the first of what will likely be more to come.
